email.subject: Keel Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Dev,

I looked at Keel Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings:

- No online booking — visitors have to call during business hours or leave, so after-hours searchers (a lot of auto care traffic) just go to the next shop.
- No click-to-call button on mobile — someone has to copy your number and dial manually instead of tapping once, and most give up.

Together those probably lose you a steady trickle of easy jobs every week.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
